meta.source: MoSPI, National Statistical Office (state estimates from each state's Directorate of Economics and Statistics)
meta.revisionPolicy: Each year is the state's latest estimate; states revise at different times and the API carries no revision label. The newest year is usually an advance or quick estimate.
meta.coverage: Each of eleven industries as a share of each state's GSVA, per cent, current prices
meta.note: Derived from states-gsva-current: industry GSVA over total GSVA at current prices, two decimals. Keys are <state>__<industry>.
